rawContent: I've been giving it a lot of thought, #BLM. You believe that I care what happens to you. In fact, you require that I care about you. After much consideration, I must state that I care about you as much as you care about me. Which is not at all. Goodnight.

Yes, black lives matter, but not any more or any less than anyone else's.  I'm sorry, #BLM. You are not superior.  You are not special.  The truth hurts sometimes. You just have to get over it like the rest of us have had to.
